scenario.name: optimistic
scenario.label: Optimistic
scenario.description: Optimistic: Each uncertain assumption (any non-fixed distribution) is tested one at a time at the low and the high end of its range, with every other assumption at its central value, and the end giving the higher cumulative dynamic revenue (revenue_dynamic_gbp_bn summed over the horizon) is used. This works the same way for rises and cuts. The profit base deviation is a macro assumption and is set by rule to its high value. Assumptions that do not change cumulative dynamic revenue, and fixed assumptions, stay at central. This is a combination of favourable assumptions under the model, not a forecast.

scenario.name: pessimistic
scenario.label: Pessimistic
scenario.description: Pessimistic: Each uncertain assumption (any non-fixed distribution) is tested one at a time at the low and the high end of its range, with every other assumption at its central value, and the end giving the lower cumulative dynamic revenue (revenue_dynamic_gbp_bn summed over the horizon) is used. This works the same way for rises and cuts. The profit base deviation is a macro assumption and is set by rule to its low value. Assumptions that do not change cumulative dynamic revenue, and fixed assumptions, stay at central. This is a combination of unfavourable assumptions under the model, not a forecast.
